$schema: Signblast word list, shared by the website and the app. Uppercase A–Z only, 2–6 letters.

daily.algorithm: seed = FNV-1a 32-bit hash of the local date 'YYYY-MM-DD'. rng = mulberry32(seed). Shuffle a copy of `words` with Fisher-Yates using rng (for i from n-1 down to 1: j = floor(rng() * (i + 1)); swap i, j). Today's five = the first 5. Both platforms must implement exactly this so everyone gets the same words.
